messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate for customer 'Mistral' on Dedicated cluster dc-eu-west-3. Alerting SRE on-call. Severity: P2. 5xx spike started ~30s ago. sample_rate=0.18, p95_latency=2.3s
Leo Zhang: I'm on it, grabbing logs + checking node metrics. Reassigning to me.
Maya Patel: FYI customer CS already saw increase in errors, Julie is on standby to update them.
Ajay Singh: any immediate mitigations? can we throttle/route?
Leo Zhang: First look - GPU load on pool gpu-pool-7 at 98%, memory inflated on a subset of hosts, and KV eviction rate jumped. Might be noisy tenant saturating KV which backs request preprocessing.
Maya Patel: customer impact: ~22% of requests return 502/504 according to ingress traces. They reported user-facing failures in their chat app.
Leo Zhang: Rolling a quick mitigation: enabling per-tenant request-shaping for Mistral to cap concurrency to 30 for now. Doing via config patch.
Ajay Singh: +1, also can we shift some of Mistral traffic to the cross-region fallback pool? That reduces latency but helps availability.
Leo Zhang: Trying reroute to eu-west-1 fallback pool now.
sre-runbooks-bot: Runbook "dedicated-noisy-tenant-mitigation" suggested actions: 1) isolate tenant 2) throttle 3) scale reserved pool 4) contact CS.
Leo Zhang: Applied throttling patch:
```
kubectl patch tenant/mistral -n dedicated --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/concurrencyLimit","value":30}]'
```
Maya Patel: Log snippet from preproc node 10.4.12.9:
```
[2026-10-12T12:05:42Z] eviction rate=0.42, kv_get_ms=185, cpu=97%, disk_iops=12000
[2026-10-12T12:05:44Z] error: downstream call timeout to model-proxy, err=gateway timeout
```
Ajay Singh: Disk I/O high is interesting — maybe checkpointing or model shard swap thrashing. Could be a filesystem hotspot.
Leo Zhang: I'm seeing a hot pod: mistral-processor-3 pinned to host hw-37. Its Q depth for sqlite/kv is high. Evicting that pod to rebalance.
Leo Zhang: Evict command:
```
kubectl drain hw-37 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Maya Patel: Eviction triggered, controller will reschedule. Monitoring for immediate 5xx drop.
Julie Kim (CS): Notifying customer support channel: "Hi Mistral team — we're seeing elevated errors; we applied routing and throttles to reduce impact. We'll follow up in 15m with status." :phone: 
Leo Zhang: After eviction and throttling p50 errors dropped, p95 latency down from 2.3s -> 1.1s, 5xx rate down from 22% -> ~9%. Still elevated.
Ajay Singh: Can we spin up a temporary burst node in dedicated pool? There is reserved burst capacity but need approval to uncap for this customer.
Maya Patel: Ops, we have a policy to allow 10% burst for P2 incidents. Recommend allowing it.
Leo Zhang: Requesting burst allocation now.
redwood-deploy-bot: Burst-capacity request submitted for cluster dc-eu-west-3, tenant mistral. ETA 90s.
Leo Zhang: Also enabling fallback to quantized model variant for Mistral (lower memory footprint) to reduce KV churn. Patching model route.
```
PATCH /v1/routing
{"tenant":"mistral","route":"/model","variant":"vq4"}
```
Ajay Singh: Good, that should reduce memory pressure.
Maya Patel: Metrics: GPU utilization down to 85%, KV eviction rate dropping to 0.12, 5xx ~4.5% now. Customer CS updated.
Julie Kim (CS): customer confirmed degraded but usable, they asked for post-incident summary. I'll coordinate.
Leo Zhang: Marking as "mitigated" for now; will continue to monitor for 30m. Opening ticket to investigate root cause — candidate: tenant-side runaway batcher + disk hotspot on hw-37 node.
Ajay Singh: Assigning follow-up to eng-runtime to look at batching heuristics. Tagging @Maya to own RCA.
Maya Patel: Acknowledged. I'll collect traces, kernel logs, and host iostat.
Leo Zhang: Final note: if we see another spike revert routing to hosted fallback and escalate to dedicated infra lead.
incident-bot: Incident updated: severity -> P3 (mitigated), assigned -> Maya Patel, follow-up ticket #INC-2026-487.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. I'll post RCA draft in ~48 hours. :memo:
